mcp_bridge_invalid_area.title: MCP Bridge "{bridge_name}" has an invalid area
mcp_bridge_invalid_area.description:
This Bridge's configured area (id: {area_id}) no longer exists in Home Assistant - it was probably deleted or renamed. Spells that rely on this Bridge's own speaking-device area cannot run until you fix this.

Open this Bridge's settings and either pick a valid area, or clear the area field to make it a deliberately area-less ("master") Bridge that always requires an explicit target.

code27_music_mode_recovery.title: CODE27 music mode may be out of sync after a reboot
code27_music_mode_recovery.description:
This device just recovered from being unavailable and immediately reported its music page as open. This has been seen live to be unreliable right after a device reboot - a suspected CODE27 firmware issue, not something Home Assistant can resolve on its own.

On the device itself, switch into music mode and back once to force a real resync, then this issue clears on its own.

code27_music_chat_conflict.title: CODE27 mode conflicts with chat activity
code27_music_chat_conflict.description: CODE27 reports Music Mode, but a new user chat message was observed. Its reported mode may be out of sync. Select the intended mode again on the device; this issue clears when CODE27 reports that the music page is closed.

code27_external_contract.title: External CODE27 hub incompatible
code27_external_contract.description: HASE cannot bind this CODE27 entry: {reason}. Check that both integrations support the same External Hub Contract.

code27_external_missing.title: Invalid CODE27 configuration
code27_external_missing.description: The standalone CODE27 entry bound to HASE no longer exists. Set up the device under the CODE27 integration, then use Reconfigure on this HASE hub to bind the new entry. Or delete this HASE hub if you no longer need it. HASE cannot run its CODE27 spells until the binding is repaired.

mcp_server.title: Set up the HASE MCP Server
mcp_server.description: Infrastructure only - it owns no Spellbook, area or scope itself, and it is a singleton (this form only ever appears once). Add MCP Bridges afterwards, one per external MCP client/device.

data_description.mcp_server_port: The internal TCP port the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint listens on. This binds on every network interface of this machine, so any device on your local network can reach it, not just this machine itself - the only thing stopping an unauthorized device on your LAN is each Bridge's own bearer token, so keep those secret and treat your local network as the security boundary. HASE does not expose this port to the internet itself - route an external hostname/path to it through your own reverse proxy, with its own authentication/TLS, if you want that. You can change this later from the MCP Server's own options, which restarts the listener on the new port immediately.

data.remote_recovery_enabled: Recover the device's LAN address via CODE27's cloud after a DHCP change

data_description.remote_recovery_enabled: Off by default. If your CODE27 gets a new LAN IP (e.g. after a router restart) and this integration can no longer reach it, enabling this lets it ask CODE27's own cloud (codie-remote.prod.code27.co - a third party, not something Home Assistant or this integration controls) once for the device's current address, verify locally that it's really this device, and update the stored host automatically. Chat, images and all other features always stay on your local network either way - the cloud is only ever asked "where is my device right now?", nothing else.
data_description.alarm_switches: On (default): every alarm also gets its own switch entity. Off: no per-alarm entities are kept - the existing ones are removed - and alarms are edited through the 'Alarms' to-do list and the dashboard card instead. Switches of alarms deleted while Home Assistant was off are cleaned up on startup.
data_description.codie_tool_bridge: MCP Bridge whose Spells Codie may cast as tools (firmware 1.6.0+). Off = no tools.
data_description.codie_agent: Codie hands the user's sentence to this agent (firmware 1.6.0+): choose a HASE Spellbooker for your own trigger phrases. Anything it does not know goes to Home Assistant's normal Assist. Empty = no home_command tool.
data_description.codie_unrestricted: On (default): Codie's sentences may act in every area your agent allows. Off: only the areas selected below - on top of the agent's own area rules, whichever is stricter.
data_description.codie_allowed_areas: Only used while "Unrestricted" is off. Codie's sentences (home_command) never reach beyond these areas.

data_description.spellbooker_no_match_response: Said when a sentence doesn't match any spellbook command. Leave empty for the default response.
data_description.spellbooker_queries_allowed_areas: Which areas this assistant may answer status queries about (e.g. "what's the temperature in X"). Independent of the actions areas above - ignored if "Unrestricted queries" is on.
data_description.spellbooker_queries_unrestricted: Allows status queries in every area, regardless of the selection above. Does not affect which areas this assistant may act in.

create_alarm.name: Create alarm
create_alarm.description: Creates a new alarm on the CODE27 device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to add the alarm to.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week the alarm repeats on. Leave empty for a one-off alarm.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the alarm is enabled right away.

update_alarm.name: Update alarm
update_alarm.description: Changes an existing alarm on the CODE27 device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry the alarm belongs to.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: The alarm's id, e.g. from the alarm switch entity's "alarm_id" attribute.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week the alarm repeats on. Leave empty for a one-off alarm.

delete_alarm.name: Delete alarm
delete_alarm.description: Removes an alarm from the CODE27 device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry the alarm belongs to.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: The alarm's id, e.g. from the alarm switch entity's "alarm_id" attribute.

send_chat_message.name: Send chat message
send_chat_message.description: Sends a text message into the CODE27 character's chat, as if you had typed it yourself.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to send the message to.

slot.name: Character slot
slot.description: Optional: which character slot to message. Defaults to the currently active character.

language.name: Language
language.description: Optional: language code (e.g. 'en', 'de') the character should reply in. Defaults to the device's own setting.

send_chat_image.name: Send chat image
send_chat_image.description: Sends an image (e.g. a camera snapshot), with an optional caption, into the CODE27 character's chat. The device rejects images over 1MB.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to send the image to.

filename.name: File path
filename.description: Full path to the image file on this Home Assistant instance (e.g. from a camera.snapshot action). Must be under an allowed directory.

message.name: Caption
message.description: Optional text to send alongside the image.

slot.name: Character slot
slot.description: Optional: which character slot to message. Defaults to the currently active character.

language.name: Language
language.description: Optional: language code (e.g. 'en', 'de') the character should reply in.

update_memory_card.name: Update memory card
update_memory_card.description: Edits a memory card's content or category. Warning: the device permanently marks the card as user-edited as soon as this is called, even if you set it back to its original content - there is no way to undo that marker.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to edit the memory card on.

character_id.name: Character ID
character_id.description: The character's cloud_id (from its character settings), not the slot number.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The memory card's id, from get_memory_cards.

content.name: Content
content.description: New content. Leave empty to only change the category.

category.name: Category
category.description: New category. Leave empty to only change the content.

get_memory_cards.name: Get memory cards
get_memory_cards.description: Reads a page of a character's memory cards. Returns response data - call with "Response variable" set, e.g. in a script or Developer Tools.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to read memory cards from.

character_id.name: Character ID
character_id.description: The character's cloud_id (from its character settings), not the slot number.

get_diary_entries.name: Get diary entries
get_diary_entries.description: Reads a page of a character's diary entries (read-only on this firmware). Returns response data - call with "Response variable" set.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to read diary entries from.

character_id.name: Character ID
character_id.description: The character's cloud_id (from its character settings), not the slot number.

slot.name: Character slot
slot.description: Required by the device alongside the character ID.

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional: only entries for this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

get_diary_entry.name: Get diary entry
get_diary_entry.description: Reads one diary entry in full. Returns response data - call with "Response variable" set.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to read the diary entry from.

character_id.name: Character ID
character_id.description: The character's cloud_id (from its character settings), not the slot number.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The diary entry's id, from get_diary_entries.

upload_music.name: Upload music
upload_music.description: Uploads an audio file to the TF card, optionally playing it right away. Confirmed live to accept more than MP3 (e.g. WAV). Requires the device's music mode to be open on-screen to actually play.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to upload to.

filename.name: File path
filename.description: Full path to the audio file on this Home Assistant instance. Must be under an allowed directory.

play.name: Play after upload
play.description: Start playing the uploaded file immediately once it's on the device.

delete_music_file.name: Delete music file
delete_music_file.description: Removes a file from the TF card by its path. Confirmed live: deleting the file currently playing does not interrupt playback (the device streams from an already-loaded buffer) - useful for a rolling upload/play/delete workflow (e.g. an RFID-triggered automation) without growing storage use over time.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to delete the file from.

path.name: Path
path.description: The file's path on the device, e.g. from upload_music's response or the music storage sensor's file list.

set_music_play_mode.name: Set music play mode
set_music_play_mode.description: Sets the playback mode for the music player (loop all, loop one, shuffle, or sequential).

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to configure.

play_mode.name: Play mode
play_mode.description: Playback mode: list_loop (repeat all), single_loop (repeat one), shuffle, or sequence (play through once).

set_music_sound_effect.name: Set music sound effect
set_music_sound_effect.description: Sets the sound effect (equalizer preset) for music playback.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to configure.

sound_effect.name: Sound effect
sound_effect.description: The sound effect / EQ preset name as accepted by the device.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Starts a stored playlist on the device, or continues it where it was last played. For buttons and tag (RFID/NFC) automations. The music screen must be open on the device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry whose playlist to play.

playlist.name: Playlist
playlist.description: The exact name of a stored playlist.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Continue at the remembered track and position. A playlist that was never played - or resume off - starts from its first track.

notify.name: Notify (blink LEDs)
notify.description: Blinks the LEDs in the given color until acknowledged (via the button entity or notify_clear). Useful for a persistent visual alert, e.g. from Node-RED.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to notify.

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional note, only shown in the notification's attributes and the log - not spoken or displayed on the device.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: RGB color to blink in, defaults to red.

speak_text.name: Speak text
speak_text.description: Optional: also speak this text out loud on the device (same as the speak action), right when the LEDs start blinking.

notify_clear.name: Clear notification
notify_clear.description: Stops the blinking started by the notify action, same as pressing the acknowledge button.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to clear the notification on.

create_memo.name: Create note or reminder
create_memo.description: Creates a note on the CODE27 device. With a date it becomes a reminder that fires once at that date and time.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry.

date.name: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Makes the note a reminder.

update_memo.name: Update note or reminder
update_memo.description: Changes a note or reminder. Only the fields you set are changed; an empty date turns a reminder back into a plain note.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry.

memo_id.name: Note ID
memo_id.description: The id of the note (shown in the memos attribute of the notes sensor).

date.name: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Makes the note a reminder.

delete_memo.name: Delete note or reminder
delete_memo.description: Deletes a note or reminder from the CODE27 device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry.

memo_id.name: Note ID
memo_id.description: The id of the note (shown in the memos attribute of the notes sensor).

set_outfit.name: Set outfit
set_outfit.description: Switches the outfit of a character on the CODE27 device (firmware 1.5.3 or newer). The device reloads the character model for about two seconds afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to switch the outfit on.

outfit.name: Outfit
outfit.description: The outfit number (1, 2, 3 ...) as listed in the Outfit select.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Character slot (1-5). Defaults to the active character.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Speaks text out loud on the CODE27 device using the active character's voice, via the device's TTS preview feature. Does not touch the chat - use send_chat_message for that.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The CODE27 config entry to speak on.

data_description.regenerate_credential: Issues a brand-new bearer token and immediately invalidates the current one. The new token is shown once on the next screen - copy it now, it cannot be shown again.

reveal_credential.title: Bridge credential
reveal_credential.description:
Bearer token for this MCP Bridge:

`{token}`

**This token is shown only once.** Copy it now and store it wherever your MCP client (e.g. Stackchan) needs it. Once you leave this page, Home Assistant cannot display it again - only a masked suffix remains visible in this Bridge's settings. If you lose it, reconfigure this Bridge and check "Regenerate token" to issue a new one - the old token stops working the moment you do.
